#Packages
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(psych)
library(ggcorrplot)
```

#Data
```{r}
data_sales <- read_excel("C:\\Users\\ASUS\\Downloads\\Data selespeople.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")
head(data_sales)
data_sales <- data_sales[,-1]
```

#Standarisasi
Akibat satuan dari tiap peubah berbeda (ada indeks dan skor) sehingga perlu dilakukan stan

```{r}
data_scale <- data.frame(scale(data_sales))
data_scale
```

```{r}
cov_scale<- cov(data_scale)
cov_scale

```

```{r}
ei <- eigen(cov_scale)
ei
```

#Analisis Faktor
##Eksplorasi Data : Korelasi Antar Peubah
```{r}
cor_sales <- cor(data_sales)
ggcorrplot(cor_sales, type = "lower", lab = TRUE)
```

## Analisis Faktor
```{r}
fa_sales1 <- fa(data_sales, nfactors = 7, fm = "minres", rotate = "none")
fa_sales1$Vaccounted
```

```{r}
SS_loadings <- fa_sales1$Vaccounted[1,]
number_of_factor <- seq_along(SS_loadings)
plot(number_of_factor, SS_loadings, type = "b", main = "Scree Plot", pch = 16)
```

# Mencari Skor Faktor dan RMS Overall
```{r}
cov_sales1 <- cov(data_sales)
cov_sales1
```

```{r}
kor_sales1 <- cov2cor(cov_sales1)
kor_sales1
```

```{r}
cov_scale1<- cov(data_scale)
ei1 <- eigen(cov_scale1)
ei1
```

```{r}
l1 <- sqrt(ei1$values[1]) * ei1$vectors[,1]
l2 <- sqrt(ei1$values[2]) * ei1$vectors[,2]

l <- cbind(l1,l2)
l
```
```{r}
t(l) %*% solve(kor_sales1)
```
## Skor Faktor

```{r}
Skor_faktor <- t(t(l) %*% solve(kor_sales1) %*% t(data_scale))
colnames(Skor_faktor) <- c("Skor Faktor 1", "Skor Faktor 2")
Skor_faktor
```



## RMS Overall Sesuai EXCEl ASPRAK
```{r}
r <- kor_sales1
ll <- l %*% t(l)
w <- matrix(0,ncol = 5, nrow = 5)
diag(w) <- diag(r)-diag(ll)
r
ll
w

```

```{r}
res <- r-(ll+w)
res
```

```{r}
res^2
```
```{r}
sum(res^2)
```
```{r}
sum(w)
```


```{r}
ressumsq <- sum(res^2)
ressumsq
```

### RMS Overall   
```{r}
rms_overall1 <- sqrt((1/(5*(5-1)))*ressumsq)
rms_overall1
```
Nilai RMS overall = 0.02037508 yang lebih kecil dari 0.05 mengindikasikan bahwa model diperoleh cukup baik.
